rules: Asset_turnover fused with price/low mean-reversion terms was this round's best niche: CS_RANK($asset_turnover) * CS_RANK((TS_MIN($low,21)/$close) - TS_MEAN($return,5)) scored fitness 7.181, and asset_turnover also drove accepts at 0.938 and 1.199. Prioritize more asset_turnover x price-reversion fusions with structurally distinct second legs.

When asset_turnover dominates a fusion's correlation, tweaking only the return-term's window doesn't decorrelate: CS_RANK($asset_turnover)*CS_RANK(TS_MEAN($return,10)-TS_MEAN($return,5)) hit rho 0.826 against the archived CS_RANK($asset_turnover)*CS_RANK(-TS_MEAN($return,5)). Change the non-fundamental leg's structure, not its window.

Same-window coefficient-of-variation (TS_STD(x,w)/TS_MEAN(x,w) at one window) is a still-open niche distinct from cross-window mean-ratio chassis: CS_RANK(TS_STD($dollar_volume,15)/TS_MEAN($dollar_volume,15)) scored 2.087, while dollar_volume cross-window-ratio x range combos hit archive_subtree 6 times this round.

Bare volume-ratio smoothing swaps still fail cheap_screen without a fundamental multiplier: EMA($volume,5)/EMA($volume,42) scored |t| 0.20, while the fundamental-fused CS_ZSCORE($accrual_gap) * volume mean-ratio passed at 3.178.

Downside-only return transforms don't rescue volume-return correlation: TS_CORR($volume, -MIN($return,0), 21) scored |t| 0.04, weaker than plain-return-volume correlations that already fail cheap_screen.

A quarter of this round's rejects (5 of 20) were exact in-run duplicates, concentrated in earnings_per_share ratio/spread variants and close-low-high range ratios. Cross-check the run's own proposal list before submitting near-identical eps or range expressions.

The high-low-range-over-TS_STD(high-low,10) chassis is now saturated: a window swap (21d, rho 0.972) and a denominator restructure (high minus TS_MIN(low,21), rho 0.915) both collapsed onto the archived CS_RANK(($high-$close)/(TS_STD($high-$low,10)+1e-8)). Stop deriving from this base.

A bare 2-node fundamental RANK (e.g. RANK($roa)) can't serve as a crossover parent since it can't donate the required 3 shared nodes: both attempted roa fusions this round (x TS_CORR(high-close,return) and x return-mean-diff) were rejected as crossover_not_a_fusion.
